strings: r_c notices that m_c struggles to see in the dark, more so than the other kits. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/r_c/speak/speaks} to m_c and discover that m_c has visual snow.

m_c is permanently seeing a snowy effect in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision, and when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/speaks/speak} to a healer about it, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/discover/discovers} that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/have/has} visual snow.
m_c casually jokes about the static in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} vision, only to find out that it is not a universal experience. It turns out m_c has visual snow.
